Name: Penis-kun the dingding - Cat replacement
Author: Reynbowz
Description:
Have you ever wanted a dingding of your very own? Now you can replace your cat with Penis-kun the dingding! Everybody loves dingdings, and now you can have one for your farm. Audio included. Pairs wonderfully with other lewd mods. Comes in three flavours: vanilla, caramel, and chocolate~

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CP[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]CM[/url].

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music[/url]﻿
[/size]
[*][size=2]Download this mod, unzip the file to get two folders
[/size]
[*][size=2]Put the two folders in the Stardew Valley/Mods folder[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game through SMAPI[/size]
[/list]
